Game Overview

Agent T Action Shooter is a arcade game built around sleek action awaits as you control Agent T, a suave operative who never stops moving through perilous mafia landscapes. Run, shoot, and dodge your way to victory with simple tap controls. Navigate mesmerizing levels and dodge deadly traps with precision and timing in this relentless platform shooter.
